title: 土堤壓密與防滲
summary: 由土料三相、調濕與乾密度出發，課程連結地基壓密時間、達西流徑、防滲牆阻抗、濾層及孔壓監測。每一步區分材料試驗與整體構造行為，特別避免把抗隆起比值當所有管湧的安全證明。西沙加緬度及紅河提供已核對背景，數學量值全部是獨立教學假設。
summaryEn: Starting from soil phases, conditioning and dry density, the course connects consolidation timing, Darcy paths, cutoff resistance, filters and pore-pressure monitoring. Each step distinguishes material tests from whole-structure behavior, especially avoiding claims that a heave ratio proves safety against all piping. West Sacramento and Red River provide verified context; every numerical value is an independent teaching assumption.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 敏感度固定一維均質層的排水長2 m及百分之九十時間因子0.848，只把壓密係數由1.0×10⁻⁷提高到1.1×10⁻⁷ m²/s。時間由392.59降至356.90日，減少9.09%，並非減少百分之十；壓密係數在分母，所以必須用倒數比例。此比較假設排水邊界、荷載與土性模型均不變，不能代表打設排水板或改變填築速度後的現場工期。這些變更還會影響排水路徑、塗抹區、井阻與荷載歷程，應另建立模型並以多深度孔壓及沉陷歷線檢核。
workedExample.textEn: Hold drainage length at 2 m and the ninety-percent time factor at 0.848 for a uniform one-dimensional layer, increasing consolidation coefficient from 1.0×10⁻⁷ to 1.1×10⁻⁷ m²/s. Time decreases from 392.59 to 356.90 days, a 9.09% reduction rather than ten percent because the coefficient enters the denominator. This comparison holds drainage boundaries, loading and the material model fixed. It does not predict construction time after adding vertical drains or changing fill rate. Such changes can alter drainage distance, smear, well resistance and loading history, requiring a different model checked against multi-depth pore-pressure and settlement histories. The uncertainty in the coefficient should therefore remain visible alongside the computed time.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「含水量與乾密度機理與驗證」與「土料調濕與拌合機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Moisture and dry density mechanism and verification" and "Moisture conditioning and blending mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 含水量與乾密度機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Moisture and dry density mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「含水量與乾密度」如何影響土堤壓密與防滲的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Moisture and dry density” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Levee compaction and seepage control”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 夯實以機械能改變土粒排列並排出部分空氣，現場濕密度同時含固體與水，必須配合含水量換算乾密度。相對夯實度還需對應相同土料及試驗能量的室內最大乾密度；不同級配、超粒徑修正或取樣位置會改變可比性，不能只追求單一百分比而忽略土層接合與滲透性。本例含水量以水重除乾土重定義，密度均為質量密度。數值只做換算，不把假設室內峰值或百分比當任何現場驗收標準。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「含水量與乾密度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Compaction rearranges particles mechanically and removes some air. Field wet density includes solids and water and must be converted using moisture content. Relative compaction additionally requires a laboratory maximum for compatible material and test energy. Gradation changes, oversize corrections and sampling location affect comparability, so one percentage cannot replace attention to lift bonding and permeability. Moisture is water mass divided by dry-solid mass, and densities are mass densities. This conversion does not make the assumed laboratory peak or resulting percentage a field acceptance criterion. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Moisture and dry density” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設濕密度ρ=2.00 Mg/m³、w=0.15，乾密度ρd=ρ/(1+w)=1.739 Mg/m³；室內峰值1.85 Mg/m³，相對夯實度94.01%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume wet density 2.00 Mg/m³ and moisture w=0.15.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「現場濕密度較高就必定表示乾密度與防滲能力都較好。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Higher field wet density necessarily means better dry density and seepage resistance." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「含水量與乾密度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Moisture and dry density”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 含水量與乾密度機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Moisture and dry density mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 夯實以機械能改變土粒排列並排出部分空氣，現場濕密度同時含固體與水，必須配合含水量換算乾密度。相對夯實度還需對應相同土料及試驗能量的室內最大乾密度；不同級配、超粒徑修正或取樣位置會改變可比性，不能只追求單一百分比而忽略土層接合與滲透性。
knowledge.textEn: Compaction rearranges particles mechanically and removes some air. Field wet density includes solids and water and must be converted using moisture content.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：現場濕密度較高就必定表示乾密度與防滲能力都較好。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Higher field wet density necessarily means better dry density and seepage resistance. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「含水量與乾密度機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Moisture and dry density mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 現場濕密度較高就必定表示乾密度與防滲能力都較好。
夯實以機械能改變土粒排列並排出部分空氣，現場濕密度同時含固體與水，必須配合含水量換算乾密度。
只要加水總量正確，每個土團就會立即具有相同含水量。
optionsEn: Higher field wet density necessarily means better dry density and seepage resistance.
Compaction rearranges particles mechanically and removes some air.
A correct total water dose immediately gives every soil clod identical moisture.
quiz.explanation: 夯實以機械能改變土粒排列並排出部分空氣，現場濕密度同時含固體與水，必須配合含水量換算乾密度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Compaction rearranges particles mechanically and removes some air. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 含水量與乾密度機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Moisture and dry density mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「含水量與乾密度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Moisture and dry density” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設濕密度ρ=2.00 Mg/m³、w=0.15，乾密度ρd=ρ/(1+w)=1.739 Mg/m³；室內峰值1.85 Mg/m³，相對夯實度94.01%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume wet density 2.00 Mg/m³ and moisture w=0.15. Dry density is 1.739 Mg/m³; relative to a laboratory maximum of 1.85 Mg/m³, compaction is 94.01%. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將密度與含水量取自可對應的土樣和位置，核對室內試驗能量、級配及超粒徑處理。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Pair density and moisture from corresponding material and locations, checking laboratory energy, gradation and oversize treatment.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設濕密度ρ=2.00 Mg/m³、w=0.15，乾密度ρd=ρ/(1+w)=1.739 Mg/m³；室內峰值1.85 Mg/m³，相對夯實度94.01%。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume wet density 2.00 Mg/m³ and moisture w=0.15. Dry density is 1.739 Mg/m³; relative to a laboratory maximum of 1.85 Mg/m³, compaction is 94.01%.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「含水量與乾密度機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Moisture and dry density mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 填土達到指定夯實度，就能證明下方軟弱地基不再壓密。
達西公式中的水位差本身就是水力坡降，不需要流徑長度。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設濕密度ρ=2.00 Mg/m³、w=0.15，乾密度ρd=ρ/(1+w)=1.739 Mg/m³。
optionsEn: Specified fill compaction proves that the underlying soft foundation will no longer consolidate.
Head difference alone is the Darcy hydraulic gradient and needs no flow-path length.
Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume wet density 2.00 Mg/m³ and moisture w=0.15.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設濕密度ρ=2.00 Mg/m³、w=0.15，乾密度ρd=ρ/(1+w)=1.739 Mg/m³；室內峰值1.85 Mg/m³，相對夯實度94.01%。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume wet density 2.00 Mg/m³ and moisture w=0.15. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 含水量與乾密度機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Moisture and dry density mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「含水量與乾密度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Moisture and dry density” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將密度與含水量取自可對應的土樣和位置，核對室內試驗能量、級配及超粒徑處理。沿每層厚度與接合帶安排檢查，異常時先追查土料和儀器校核，不能用另一處含水量替代。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Pair density and moisture from corresponding material and locations, checking laboratory energy, gradation and oversize treatment. Inspect lift thickness and transitions as well as point density; investigate material changes and instrument calibration before substituting moisture measurements from another location. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以兩組相同濕密度但不同含水量重算乾密度，再列出室內與現場必須一致的條件。說明為何密度比較仍不能代替滲透試驗和層間連續性檢查。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate dry density for equal wet densities at two moisture contents, then list laboratory and field comparability conditions. Explain why density comparison still cannot replace permeability testing and inspection of continuity between lifts.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：濕土可能有較高濕密度卻較低乾密度，誤用不同材料的室內峰值會造成錯誤合格判斷；局部表面測得密實也可能掩蓋厚層底部未壓實。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Wet soil may show high bulk density but low dry density. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將密度與含水量取自可對應的土樣和位置，核對室內試驗能量、級配及超粒徑處理。沿每層厚度與接合帶安排檢查，異常時先追查土料和儀器校核，不能用另一處含水量替代。
knowledge.textEn: Pair density and moisture from corresponding material and locations, checking laboratory energy, gradation and oversize treatment. Inspect lift thickness and transitions as well as point density; investigate material changes and instrument calibration before substituting moisture measurements from another location.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以兩組相同濕密度但不同含水量重算乾密度，再列出室內與現場必須一致的條件。說明為何密度比較仍不能代替滲透試驗和層間連續性檢查。
knowledge.textEn: Recalculate dry density for equal wet densities at two moisture contents, then list laboratory and field comparability conditions. Explain why density comparison still cannot replace permeability testing and inspection of continuity between lifts.

quiz.question: 要驗證「含水量與乾密度機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Moisture and dry density mechanism and verification"?
options: 將密度與含水量取自可對應的土樣和位置，核對室內試驗能量、級配及超粒徑處理。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
牆材滲透係數很低，就能忽略所有牆尖繞流與施工接頭。
optionsEn: Pair density and moisture from corresponding material and locations, checking laboratory energy, gradation and oversize treatment.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Very low wall-material conductivity makes all tip bypass and construction joints irrelevant.
quiz.explanation: 將密度與含水量取自可對應的土樣和位置，核對室內試驗能量、級配及超粒徑處理。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Pair density and moisture from corresponding material and locations, checking laboratory energy, gradation and oversize treatment. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 含水量與乾密度機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Moisture and dry density mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「含水量與乾密度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Moisture and dry density” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 濕土可能有較高濕密度卻較低乾密度，誤用不同材料的室內峰值會造成錯誤合格判斷；局部表面測得密實也可能掩蓋厚層底部未壓實。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Wet soil may show high bulk density but low dry density. A laboratory peak from different material misclassifies acceptance, while a dense surface can conceal an inadequately compacted lower part of a thick lift. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：數值只做換算，不把假設室內峰值或百分比當任何現場驗收標準。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: This conversion does not make the assumed laboratory peak or resulting percentage a field acceptance criterion.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「現場濕密度較高就必定表示乾密度與防滲能力都較好。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Higher field wet density necessarily means better dry density and seepage resistance." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 濕土可能有較高濕密度卻較低乾密度，誤用不同材料的室內峰值會造成錯誤合格判斷；局部表面測得密實也可能掩蓋厚層底部未壓實。
knowledge.textEn: Wet soil may show high bulk density but low dry density. A laboratory peak from different material misclassifies acceptance, while a dense surface can conceal an inadequately compacted lower part of a thick lift.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「含水量與乾密度機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Moisture and dry density mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
濕土可能有較高濕密度卻較低乾密度，誤用不同材料的室內峰值會造成錯誤合格判斷；局部表面測得密實也可能掩蓋厚層底部未壓實。
只要加水總量正確，每個土團就會立即具有相同含水量。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Wet soil may show high bulk density but low dry density.
A correct total water dose immediately gives every soil clod identical moisture.
quiz.explanation: 濕土可能有較高濕密度卻較低乾密度，誤用不同材料的室內峰值會造成錯誤合格判斷；局部表面測得密實也可能掩蓋厚層底部未壓實。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Wet soil may show high bulk density but low dry density. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 土料調濕與拌合機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Moisture conditioning and blending mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「土料調濕與拌合」如何影響土堤壓密與防滲的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Moisture conditioning and blending” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Levee compaction and seepage control”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 土料調濕改變施工時的可壓實性，但最佳含水量隨土性與夯實能量而異。加水計畫需以乾土質量建立水量帳，再考慮拌合均勻度、蒸發與雨水；平均含水量符合目標不代表每一團塊都符合，過濕或乾硬團塊仍可能留下不同變形與滲流通道。本例封閉水量帳假設乾土質量不變、加入的水全部保留，目標只是指定教學值，不宣稱位於最佳含水量或可立即施工。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「土料調濕與拌合」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Moisture conditioning changes compactability, but optimum moisture depends on material and compaction energy. Added water is calculated from dry-solid mass before accounting for mixing, evaporation and rainfall. Meeting an average moisture target does not mean every clod meets it; wet pockets and hard dry clods can produce contrasting deformation and seepage paths. The closed water balance holds dry mass fixed and retains all added water. The target is an assigned teaching value, not a demonstrated optimum or authorization to place the soil. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Moisture conditioning and blending” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設乾土Md=1000 kg，初始w1=0.12、目標w2=0.15，需加水ΔMw=Md(w2−w1)=30 kg。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume dry soil Md=1000 kg, initial moisture w1=0.12 and target w2=0.15.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要加水總量正確，每個土團就會立即具有相同含水量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A correct total water dose immediately gives every soil clod identical moisture." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「土料調濕與拌合」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Moisture conditioning and blending”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 誤解：只要加水總量正確，每個土團就會立即具有相同含水量。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A correct total water dose immediately gives every soil clod identical moisture. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「土料調濕與拌合機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Moisture conditioning and blending mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 只要加水總量正確，每個土團就會立即具有相同含水量。
相同乾密度的兩份土一定具有相同飽和度與滲透係數。
土料調濕改變施工時的可壓實性，但最佳含水量隨土性與夯實能量而異。
optionsEn: A correct total water dose immediately gives every soil clod identical moisture.
Two soils with equal dry density necessarily have equal saturation and hydraulic conductivity.
Moisture conditioning changes compactability, but optimum moisture depends on material and compaction energy.

quiz.explanationEn: Moisture conditioning changes compactability, but optimum moisture depends on material and compaction energy. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 土料調濕與拌合機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Moisture conditioning and blending mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「土料調濕與拌合」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Moisture conditioning and blending” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設乾土Md=1000 kg，初始w1=0.12、目標w2=0.15，需加水ΔMw=Md(w2−w1)=30 kg。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume dry soil Md=1000 kg, initial moisture w1=0.12 and target w2=0.15. Required retained water ΔMw=Md(w2−w1)=30 kg. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：先核對含水量分母為乾土質量，追蹤加水計量、天候及拌合後各點試樣。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Confirm the dry-mass moisture denominator and track metered water, weather and samples after blending.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設乾土Md=1000 kg，初始w1=0.12、目標w2=0.15，需加水ΔMw=Md(w2−w1)=30 kg。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume dry soil Md=1000 kg, initial moisture w1=0.12 and target w2=0.15. Required retained water ΔMw=Md(w2−w1)=30 kg.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「土料調濕與拌合機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Moisture conditioning and blending mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設乾土Md=1000 kg，初始w1=0.12、目標w2=0.15，需加水ΔMw=Md(w2−w1)=30 kg。
土層厚度減半時，所有情況的壓密時間都只會減半。
抗隆起比值大於一，就能排除所有逆向侵蝕與管湧機制。
optionsEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume dry soil Md=1000 kg, initial moisture w1=0.12 and target w2=0.15.
Halving soil thickness always halves consolidation time under every drainage condition.
A heave ratio above one eliminates every backward-erosion and piping mechanism.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設乾土Md=1000 kg，初始w1=0.12、目標w2=0.15，需加水ΔMw=Md(w2−w1)=30 kg。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume dry soil Md=1000 kg, initial moisture w1=0.12 and target w2=0.15. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 土料調濕與拌合機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Moisture conditioning and blending mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「土料調濕與拌合」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Moisture conditioning and blending” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 先核對含水量分母為乾土質量，追蹤加水計量、天候及拌合後各點試樣。利用試驗填築確認鬆鋪厚度、機具與遍數，並比較表層和內部含水量以辨識混合不均。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Confirm the dry-mass moisture denominator and track metered water, weather and samples after blending. Use trial placement to establish loose-lift thickness, equipment and passes, comparing surface and interior moisture to detect uneven mixing rather than relying solely on a delivered water total. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把乾土質量、水量與可能蒸發分開列帳，另設幾個混合後取樣點。比較平均合格但離散很大的情況，提出能辨識土團內外差異的驗證方式。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Separate dry mass, water dose and possible evaporation in a ledger, with several post-mixing sample locations. Compare a compliant mean with high scatter and propose verification that distinguishes clod interiors from their surfaces.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：以濕土總重乘含水量差會算錯加水量，短時間表面灑水也可能只弄濕外皮；直接增加機具遍數未必能補救內部含水量不適或團塊未打散。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Multiplying moisture change by wet total mass gives the wrong dose. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「土料調濕與拌合機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Moisture conditioning and blending mechanism and verification"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。

steps.title: 土料調濕與拌合機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Moisture conditioning and blending mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「土料調濕與拌合」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Moisture conditioning and blending” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 以濕土總重乘含水量差會算錯加水量，短時間表面灑水也可能只弄濕外皮；直接增加機具遍數未必能補救內部含水量不適或團塊未打散。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Multiplying moisture change by wet total mass gives the wrong dose. Brief surface spraying can wet only the exterior, and additional passes may not correct unsuitable interior moisture or clods that remain intact. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本例封閉水量帳假設乾土質量不變、加入的水全部保留，目標只是指定教學值，不宣稱位於最佳含水量或可立即施工。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要加水總量正確，每個土團就會立即具有相同含水量。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A correct total water dose immediately gives every soil clod identical moisture." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Void ratio and saturation mechanism and verification" and "Primary consolidation settlement mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 孔隙比與飽和度機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑

steps.instruction: 堤身機械夯實與軟弱地基的壓密是不同過程：新增填土荷載可先引起孔壓，之後排水使有效應力增加與孔隙減少。正常固結土在指定應力範圍可用壓縮指數估算一次壓密量，但超固結、分層、次壓縮或側向變形需要另處理，不能把現場夯實百分比當作地基沉陷保證。本例為均質正常固結層的一維平均應力近似，使用常用十進對數。忽略側移與次壓縮，並不代表實際堤頂最終總沉陷。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「地基一次壓密沉陷」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Mechanical compaction of fill differs from consolidation of soft foundation soil. New loading initially creates pore pressure; drainage then increases effective stress and reduces void space. A compression index estimates primary settlement for normally consolidated soil within its tested stress range. Overconsolidation, layering, secondary compression and lateral deformation require additional treatment beyond fill-density acceptance. This is a one-dimensional mean-stress estimate for a uniform normally consolidated layer using base-ten logarithms. Lateral movement and secondary compression are omitted, so the result is not total final crest settlement. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Primary consolidation settlement” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume H=4 m, Cc=0.25, e0=0.80, initial effective stress 100 kPa and increase 50 kPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「填土達到指定夯實度，就能證明下方軟弱地基不再壓密。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.check: 系統圖標明「地基一次壓密沉陷」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Primary consolidation settlement”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 地基一次壓密沉陷機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Primary consolidation settlement mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 堤身機械夯實與軟弱地基的壓密是不同過程：新增填土荷載可先引起孔壓，之後排水使有效應力增加與孔隙減少。正常固結土在指定應力範圍可用壓縮指數估算一次壓密量，但超固結、分層、次壓縮或側向變形需要另處理，不能把現場夯實百分比當作地基沉陷保證。
knowledge.textEn: Mechanical compaction of fill differs from consolidation of soft foundation soil. New loading initially creates pore pressure; drainage then increases effective stress and reduces void space.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：填土達到指定夯實度，就能證明下方軟弱地基不再壓密。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Specified fill compaction proves that the underlying soft foundation will no longer consolidate. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「地基一次壓密沉陷機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Primary consolidation settlement mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 填土達到指定夯實度，就能證明下方軟弱地基不再壓密。
堤身機械夯實與軟弱地基的壓密是不同過程：新增填土荷載可先引起孔壓，之後排水使有效應力增加與孔隙減少。
土層厚度減半時，所有情況的壓密時間都只會減半。
optionsEn: Specified fill compaction proves that the underlying soft foundation will no longer consolidate.
Mechanical compaction of fill differs from consolidation of soft foundation soil.
Halving soil thickness always halves consolidation time under every drainage condition.
quiz.explanation: 堤身機械夯實與軟弱地基的壓密是不同過程：新增填土荷載可先引起孔壓，之後排水使有效應力增加與孔隙減少。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Mechanical compaction of fill differs from consolidation of soft foundation soil. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 地基一次壓密沉陷機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Primary consolidation settlement mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「地基一次壓密沉陷」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Primary consolidation settlement” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設H=4 m、Cc=0.25、e0=0.80、初始σ′0=100 kPa、增量Δσ′=50 kPa，S=CcH log10(150/100)/(1+e0)=0.09783 m。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume H=4 m, Cc=0.25, e0=0.80, initial effective stress 100 kPa and increase 50 kPa. Primary settlement S=CcH log10(150/100)/(1+e0)=0.09783 m. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對原狀取樣品質、先期固結壓力與實際新增應力分布，將地層細分後比較結果。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check sample quality, preconsolidation stress and the distribution of added stress, comparing a layered calculation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Plausible values of two particle ratios prove complete filter acceptance for every soil type.

steps.title: 地基一次壓密沉陷機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Primary consolidation settlement mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「地基一次壓密沉陷」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Primary consolidation settlement” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對原狀取樣品質、先期固結壓力與實際新增應力分布，將地層細分後比較結果。利用沉陷板與孔壓同步觀測區別排水壓密與側移，並保留填築階段及水位變動紀錄。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check sample quality, preconsolidation stress and the distribution of added stress, comparing a layered calculation. Observe settlement plates and pore pressures together to distinguish drainage-driven consolidation from lateral movement, retaining fill-stage and groundwater records when interpreting displacement. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將一層地基分成兩個應力不同的子層並比較總沉陷，列出先期固結壓力不足時的資料缺口。規劃沉陷與孔壓配對觀測，避免只從單一沉陷值推斷原因。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Divide the foundation into two layers with different stress changes and compare total settlement. List missing preconsolidation information and plan paired settlement/pore-pressure observations instead of inferring the mechanism from one displacement value.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把超固結層全用正常固結斜率可能失真，用總應力代替有效應力也會錯估壓縮；只測堤頂而不分地基和填土，則難以辨識沉陷機制與後續變形。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using a virgin-compression slope throughout overconsolidated soil distorts settlement, as does substituting total for effective stress. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「地基一次壓密沉陷機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Primary consolidation settlement mechanism and verification"?
options: 核對原狀取樣品質、先期固結壓力與實際新增應力分布，將地層細分後比較結果。

Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Higher field wet density necessarily means better dry density and seepage resistance.
quiz.explanation: 核對原狀取樣品質、先期固結壓力與實際新增應力分布，將地層細分後比較結果。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check sample quality, preconsolidation stress and the distribution of added stress, comparing a layered calculation. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 地基一次壓密沉陷機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Primary consolidation settlement mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「地基一次壓密沉陷」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Primary consolidation settlement” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把超固結層全用正常固結斜率可能失真，用總應力代替有效應力也會錯估壓縮；只測堤頂而不分地基和填土，則難以辨識沉陷機制與後續變形。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using a virgin-compression slope throughout overconsolidated soil distorts settlement, as does substituting total for effective stress. Crest observations alone cannot separate foundation and fill contributions or identify the mechanism of continuing movement. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：忽略側移與次壓縮，並不代表實際堤頂最終總沉陷。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Lateral movement and secondary compression are omitted, so the result is not total final crest settlement.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「填土達到指定夯實度，就能證明下方軟弱地基不再壓密。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Specified fill compaction proves that the underlying soft foundation will no longer consolidate." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 把超固結層全用正常固結斜率可能失真，用總應力代替有效應力也會錯估壓縮；只測堤頂而不分地基和填土，則難以辨識沉陷機制與後續變形。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「地基一次壓密沉陷機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Primary consolidation settlement mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
把超固結層全用正常固結斜率可能失真，用總應力代替有效應力也會錯估壓縮；只測堤頂而不分地基和填土，則難以辨識沉陷機制與後續變形。

Using a virgin-compression slope throughout overconsolidated soil distorts settlement, as does substituting total for effective stress.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「排水路徑與壓密時間機理與驗證」與「滲流量與流徑長度機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Drainage path and consolidation time mechanism and verification" and "Seepage discharge and path length mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 排水路徑與壓密時間機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Drainage path and consolidation time mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「排水路徑與壓密時間」如何影響土堤壓密與防滲的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Drainage path and consolidation time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Levee compaction and seepage control”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 一次壓密時間由排水距離平方和壓密係數控制；雙向排水時的最長路徑不同於整層厚度。壓密係數會隨應力與土層而變，排水邊界也可能因低透水覆層或堵塞而改變，因此施工階段的孔壓消散不能只由一個實驗值和日曆時間決定，需與沉陷歷線一起判讀。本例使用均質一維壓密的平均百分之九十時間因子，瞬時均布荷載且排水邊界固定。係數明列為平方公尺每秒，換算日數另除秒數。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「排水路徑與壓密時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Primary consolidation time scales with the square of drainage distance and inversely with the coefficient of consolidation. Double drainage changes the longest path relative to full layer thickness. Stress-dependent properties, low-permeability covers and clogged drains can alter the response, so elapsed time and one laboratory coefficient cannot alone establish field pore-pressure dissipation. The example uses the average ninety-percent time factor for uniform one-dimensional consolidation under instantaneous uniform loading and fixed drainage boundaries. The coefficient is in square metres per second, with a separate seconds-to-days conversion. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Drainage path and consolidation time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設Tv,90=0.848、排水長Hdr=2 m、cv=1×10⁻⁷ m²/s，t90=TvHdr²/cv=33,920,000 s=392.59日。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Tv,90=0.848, drainage length Hdr=2 m and cv=1×10⁻⁷ m²/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「土層厚度減半時，所有情況的壓密時間都只會減半。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Halving soil thickness always halves consolidation time under every drainage condition." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「排水路徑與壓密時間」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Drainage path and consolidation time”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 排水路徑與壓密時間機理與驗證

knowledge.textEn: Primary consolidation time scales with the square of drainage distance and inversely with the coefficient of consolidation. Double drainage changes the longest path relative to full layer thickness.

steps.title: 滲流量與流徑長度機理與驗證：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「滲流量與流徑長度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。

steps.instruction: 標出總水頭測點、流向、面積和路徑長度，核對滲透試驗方向與現場分層。用實測孔壓和排水流量一起校核；如有異向性、裂縫或明顯自由面，改採能表示該幾何的模型。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Label total-head points, flow direction, area and path length, checking test orientation against layering. Calibrate with both pore pressures and drain discharge; where anisotropy, cracks or a moving free surface matter, use a model that represents that geometry explicitly. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把水頭差和流長各改一倍，分別比較坡降與流量，再畫出測點高程。說明總水頭含壓力水頭與位置水頭，避免把不同高度的壓力表直接相減。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Double head difference and path length separately and compare gradient and discharge. Draw measurement elevations and explain total head as pressure plus elevation head, avoiding direct subtraction of pressure readings at different heights.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：漏掉流徑長度會造成量綱錯誤，誤用沿流向面積也會使流量失真；只以總流量穩定判定安全，則可能看不到局部裂縫流逐漸集中與顆粒流失。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Omitting path length creates a dimensional error, and using area parallel to flow distorts discharge. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 滲流量與流徑長度機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Seepage discharge and path length mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「滲流量與流徑長度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Seepage discharge and path length” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 漏掉流徑長度會造成量綱錯誤，誤用沿流向面積也會使流量失真；只以總流量穩定判定安全，則可能看不到局部裂縫流逐漸集中與顆粒流失。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Omitting path length creates a dimensional error, and using area parallel to flow distorts discharge. Stable total leakage alone can conceal progressively concentrated crack flow and soil loss within a small part of the system. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：未模擬自由水面、接縫或繞過防滲構造的流線。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: It omits the phreatic surface, joints and paths around seepage-control structures.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「達西公式中的水位差本身就是水力坡降，不需要流徑長度。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Head difference alone is the Darcy hydraulic gradient and needs no flow-path length." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
A heave ratio above one eliminates every backward-erosion and piping mechanism.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「出口隆起與內部侵蝕區別機理與驗證」與「防滲牆與串聯水力阻抗機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Exit heave versus internal erosion mechanism and verification" and "Cutoff walls and series resistance mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 出口隆起與內部侵蝕區別機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Exit heave versus internal erosion mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「出口隆起與內部侵蝕區別」如何影響土堤壓密與防滲的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Exit heave versus internal erosion” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Levee compaction and seepage control”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 向上滲流的滲透力可抵消顆粒的浮重，在理想非黏性土柱中有效應力趨近零時可能隆起。這種垂直臨界梯度分析不等於水平逆向侵蝕或裂縫集中沖蝕的門檻；內部侵蝕還受級配、濾層、幾何與缺陷控制，不能把抗隆起比值命名為涵蓋一切管湧的安全係數。本例無覆載、均質非黏性土且出口垂直向上，僅比較理想臨界梯度與指定局部梯度；不能據此核准堤防或濾層配置。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「出口隆起與內部侵蝕區別」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Upward seepage force can counter submerged particle weight, approaching zero effective stress in an ideal cohesionless column and allowing heave. This vertical critical-gradient calculation is not the onset criterion for horizontal backward erosion or concentrated crack erosion. Internal erosion also depends on gradation, filters, geometry and defects, so a heave ratio cannot represent every piping mechanism. The example has no surcharge and uses uniform cohesionless soil with vertical upward exit flow. It compares ideal critical and assigned local gradients only, not approval of an embankment or filter arrangement. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Exit heave versus internal erosion” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設Gs=2.65、e=0.65、垂直出口梯度ie=0.40，icr=(Gs−1)/(1+e)=1.00，理想抗隆起比icr/ie=2.50。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Gs=2.65, e=0.65 and vertical exit gradient ie=0.40.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「抗隆起比值大於一，就能排除所有逆向侵蝕與管湧機制。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A heave ratio above one eliminates every backward-erosion and piping mechanism." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「出口隆起與內部侵蝕區別」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Exit heave versus internal erosion”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 防滲牆與串聯水力阻抗機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Cutoff walls and series resistance mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「防滲牆與串聯水力阻抗」如何影響土堤壓密與防滲的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cutoff walls and series resistance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Levee compaction and seepage control”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 低透水防滲牆可以增加理想流路的水力阻抗，但效果取決於接頭、嵌入深度和周邊地層連續性。串聯阻抗把每段長度除滲透係數與面積後相加，適合展示低透水薄層的重要性；真實水流會繞過牆尖、側緣或施工缺陷，所以一維小流量不代表牆後壓力和局部出口都已降低。本例所有水量必須依序通過兩段相同截面，牆無缺陷且不存在繞流；僅為阻抗比較，不能當二維防滲牆設計成果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「防滲牆與串聯水力阻抗」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A low-conductivity cutoff increases resistance along an ideal path, but effectiveness depends on joints, penetration and surrounding strata. Series resistance sums each length divided by conductivity and area, illustrating a thin low-permeability layer. Actual flow may bypass tips, edges or defects, so a small one-dimensional discharge does not prove favorable downstream pressures and exit gradients. All flow in this example crosses two equal-area sections in series through a defect-free wall without bypass. It is a resistance comparison rather than a two-dimensional cutoff-wall design result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Cutoff walls and series resistance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設Δh=3 m、A=10 m²，牆厚0.6 m、kw=10⁻⁹ m/s，土長29.4 m、ks=10⁻⁵ m/s，Q=Δh/[Lw/(kwA)+Ls/(ksA)]=4.976×10⁻⁸ m³/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Δh=3 m and A=10 m²: wall Lw=0.6 m, kw=10⁻⁹ m/s; soil Ls=29.4 m, ks=10⁻⁵ m/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「牆材滲透係數很低，就能忽略所有牆尖繞流與施工接頭。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Very low wall-material conductivity makes all tip bypass and construction joints irrelevant." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「防滲牆與串聯水力阻抗」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 防滲牆與串聯水力阻抗機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Cutoff walls and series resistance mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「防滲牆與串聯水力阻抗」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Cutoff walls and series resistance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對牆體連續性、施工接頭和嵌入地層，將穿牆與繞牆路徑分開建模。用牆前後孔壓及排水量辨識壓降位置，必要時檢查不連續缺陷，避免只比較材料試體的滲透係數。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Verify wall continuity, joints and the penetrated stratum, modeling through-wall and bypass paths separately. Use upstream/downstream pressures and discharge to locate head loss, investigating discontinuities where necessary instead of comparing laboratory wall-material conductivity alone as evidence of overall performance. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：在串聯模型旁增設一條假設平行缺陷，分別列各路的壓差和阻抗。比較總流量及壓降分配，指出現場哪些量測能區分材料不良與繞流問題。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Add a hypothetical parallel defect beside the series path and list head differences and resistances separately. Compare total discharge and head-loss distribution, identifying measurements that distinguish poor wall material from hydraulic bypass.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：低透水試體不能保證接縫同樣密實，一條高透水缺陷可成平行流路而破壞串聯假設；僅延長牆深而不檢查出口，也可能把壓降集中到不利位置。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A low-conductivity specimen does not prove joint continuity. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 防滲牆與串聯水力阻抗機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Cutoff walls and series resistance mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「防滲牆與串聯水力阻抗」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Cutoff walls and series resistance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 低透水試體不能保證接縫同樣密實，一條高透水缺陷可成平行流路而破壞串聯假設；僅延長牆深而不檢查出口，也可能把壓降集中到不利位置。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A low-conductivity specimen does not prove joint continuity. One permeable defect creates a parallel path that invalidates the series model, while deeper penetration without checking exits may concentrate head loss in an unfavorable location. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本例所有水量必須依序通過兩段相同截面，牆無缺陷且不存在繞流；僅為阻抗比較，不能當二維防滲牆設計成果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: It is a resistance comparison rather than a two-dimensional cutoff-wall design result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「牆材滲透係數很低，就能忽略所有牆尖繞流與施工接頭。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Very low wall-material conductivity makes all tip bypass and construction joints irrelevant." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「防滲牆與串聯水力阻抗機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Cutoff walls and series resistance mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
兩個粒徑比看起來合理，就能證明任何土類的濾層完整合格。
低透水試體不能保證接縫同樣密實，一條高透水缺陷可成平行流路而破壞串聯假設；僅延長牆深而不檢查出口，也可能把壓降集中到不利位置。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Plausible values of two particle ratios prove complete filter acceptance for every soil type.
A low-conductivity specimen does not prove joint continuity.
quiz.explanation: 低透水試體不能保證接縫同樣密實，一條高透水缺陷可成平行流路而破壞串聯假設；僅延長牆深而不檢查出口，也可能把壓降集中到不利位置。 需以量測區分可能原因。

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「濾層保土與通水機理與驗證」與「孔壓監測與總水頭機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Filter retention and drainage mechanism and verification" and "Pore-pressure monitoring and total head mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 濾層保土與通水機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Filter retention and drainage mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「濾層保土與通水」如何影響土堤壓密與防滲的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Filter retention and drainage” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Levee compaction and seepage control”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 濾層需在土料流失前形成可靠的顆粒截留，同時讓水排出而不累積不利孔壓。粒徑比是篩選工具，適用界線取決於基土類別、細料比例、分散性和採用的設計程序；施工離析、污染或濾層中斷會使合格室內級配失去意義，因此保土、通水與連續性都需驗證。本例只算兩個粒徑比，未指定土類或完整設計準則，因此不能標示濾層合格。粒徑均取各自累積通過曲線對應百分位。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「濾層保土與通水」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Filters must retain migrating base particles while passing water without adverse pressure buildup. Particle-size ratios are screening tools whose limits depend on base-soil category, fines, dispersivity and the selected procedure. Segregation, contamination or interrupted placement can defeat a compliant laboratory gradation, so retention, drainage and continuity all require verification in the completed work. The example computes two grain-size ratios without specifying soil class or a complete design procedure, so it cannot declare acceptance. Diameters refer to the appropriate percent-finer points on their respective curves. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Filter retention and drainage” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設濾料D15=0.60 mm，基土d85=0.20 mm、d15=0.05 mm，保土指標比D15/d85=3，通水指標比D15/d15=12。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume filter D15=0.60 mm, base d85=0.20 mm and base d15=0.05 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩個粒徑比看起來合理，就能證明任何土類的濾層完整合格。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Plausible values of two particle ratios prove complete filter acceptance for every soil type." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「濾層保土與通水」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Filter retention and drainage”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 誤解：兩個粒徑比看起來合理，就能證明任何土類的濾層完整合格。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「濾層保土與通水機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Filter retention and drainage mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 濾層需在土料流失前形成可靠的顆粒截留，同時讓水排出而不累積不利孔壓。

optionsEn: Filters must retain migrating base particles while passing water without adverse pressure buildup.
Plausible values of two particle ratios prove complete filter acceptance for every soil type.
The higher pressure reading always identifies the upstream sensor regardless of installation elevation.

steps.title: 濾層保土與通水機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Filter retention and drainage mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「濾層保土與通水」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Filter retention and drainage” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設濾料D15=0.60 mm，基土d85=0.20 mm、d15=0.05 mm，保土指標比D15/d85=3，通水指標比D15/d15=12。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume filter D15=0.60 mm, base d85=0.20 mm and base d15=0.05 mm. Screening ratios are D15/d85=3 and D15/d15=12, without an acceptance claim. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對代表性基土完整級配與分散性，按選定手冊土類步驟設計並檢查濾料生產範圍。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check representative full base gradations and dispersivity, follow the chosen manual’s soil-category procedure and review production limits.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設濾料D15=0.60 mm，基土d85=0.20 mm、d15=0.05 mm，保土指標比D15/d85=3，通水指標比D15/d15=12。

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「濾層保土與通水機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Filter retention and drainage mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 只要加水總量正確，每個土團就會立即具有相同含水量。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設濾料D15=0.60 mm，基土d85=0.20 mm、d15=0.05 mm，保土指標比D15/d85=3，通水指標比D15/d15=12。
填土達到指定夯實度，就能證明下方軟弱地基不再壓密。
optionsEn: A correct total water dose immediately gives every soil clod identical moisture.
Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume filter D15=0.60 mm, base d85=0.20 mm and base d15=0.05 mm.

quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume filter D15=0.60 mm, base d85=0.20 mm and base d15=0.05 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 濾層保土與通水機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Filter retention and drainage mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「濾層保土與通水」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Filter retention and drainage” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對代表性基土完整級配與分散性，按選定手冊土類步驟設計並檢查濾料生產範圍。施工時追蹤離析、厚度、污染和接縫，必要時用相容性試驗驗證，而不是只留兩個比值。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check representative full base gradations and dispersivity, follow the chosen manual’s soil-category procedure and review production limits. Inspect segregation, thickness, contamination and transitions during placement, using compatibility testing when needed instead of retaining only two screening ratios in the acceptance record. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.instruction: 用平均基土掩蓋最不利細粒層會漏掉保土需求，運輸離析又可能形成局部粗料窗；即使顆粒比合理，濾層中斷仍讓集中滲流直接侵蝕未保護基土。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.title: 孔壓監測與總水頭機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Pore-pressure monitoring and total head mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「孔壓監測與總水頭」如何影響土堤壓密與防滲的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pore-pressure monitoring and total head” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Levee compaction and seepage control”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 孔壓計量到的是感測點附近壓力，解讀滲流需要把壓力水頭加到感測器高程，並統一氣壓補償與時間基準。若不分感測器高度而直接比較壓力數值，可能誤判流向；水頭變化還應結合排水流量、濁度和填築歷史，才能區別洪水邊界變動、儀器漂移與局部異常。本例使用已扣氣壓的表壓與同一高程基準，忽略速度水頭。總水頭是該點水力勢，不自動等於另一處自由地下水面位置。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「孔壓監測與總水頭」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A piezometer measures pressure near its sensor; seepage interpretation adds pressure head to sensor elevation and aligns atmospheric compensation and timestamps. Comparing pressure alone at different heights can reverse an inferred flow direction. Head changes should also be assessed with discharge, turbidity and construction history to distinguish changing flood boundaries, instrument drift and local anomalies. The example uses gauge pressure after atmospheric correction and one elevation datum, neglecting velocity head. Point total head represents hydraulic potential, not automatically the free groundwater surface at another location. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Pore-pressure monitoring and total head” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設感測器高程z=12 m、表孔壓u=29.43 kPa、水單位重γw=9.81 kN/m³，總水頭h=z+u/γw=15 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume sensor elevation z=12 m, gauge pore pressure u=29.43 kPa and water unit weight γw=9.81 kN/m³.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩支孔壓計讀值較大的那支，無論安裝高度如何都位於上游。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The higher pressure reading always identifies the upstream sensor regardless of installation elevation." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「孔壓監測與總水頭」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設感測器高程z=12 m、表孔壓u=29.43 kPa、水單位重γw=9.81 kN/m³，總水頭h=z+u/γw=15 m。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「孔壓監測與總水頭」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。

steps.instruction: 保留安裝高程、零點、氣壓與校正紀錄，確認量程及觀測頻率適合洪水變化。比較多測點總水頭和出水量濁度，異常先交叉檢核儀器及邊界，不用單支感測器代表整段堤防。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Retain installation elevation, zero, atmospheric and calibration records and match range and frequency to flood changes. Compare total head across instruments with discharge and turbidity, cross-checking equipment and boundaries before allowing one sensor to represent an entire embankment reach. steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An elevation-datum error systematically shifts inferred heads, while blockage or lost communication may mimic stability. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

knowledge.text: 給兩支不同高度感測器相同表壓，計算總水頭並判斷可能流向。再加入儀器零點偏移，列出需要哪些獨立量測才能區分真實滲流改變與感測錯誤。
knowledge.textEn: Give two sensors at different elevations equal gauge pressures, compute total heads and infer possible flow direction. Add a zero offset and list independent observations needed to distinguish an actual seepage change from measurement error.

quiz.question: 要驗證「孔壓監測與總水頭機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Pore-pressure monitoring and total head mechanism and verification"?
options: 保留安裝高程、零點、氣壓與校正紀錄，確認量程及觀測頻率適合洪水變化。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
抗隆起比值大於一，就能排除所有逆向侵蝕與管湧機制。
optionsEn: Retain installation elevation, zero, atmospheric and calibration records and match range and frequency to flood changes.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A heave ratio above one eliminates every backward-erosion and piping mechanism.
quiz.explanation: 保留安裝高程、零點、氣壓與校正紀錄，確認量程及觀測頻率適合洪水變化。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Retain installation elevation, zero, atmospheric and calibration records and match range and frequency to flood changes. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 孔壓監測與總水頭機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Pore-pressure monitoring and total head mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「孔壓監測與總水頭」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Pore-pressure monitoring and total head” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 基準高程錯誤會使所有水頭判讀系統性偏移，堵塞或失聯也可能假裝平穩；如果只設水位警戒而不追蹤出砂，即使孔壓變化不大仍可能漏掉侵蝕發展。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An elevation-datum error systematically shifts inferred heads, while blockage or lost communication may mimic stability. A stage-only alarm without sediment observations can miss erosion developing even when measured pore-pressure changes remain modest. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：總水頭是該點水力勢，不自動等於另一處自由地下水面位置。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Point total head represents hydraulic potential, not automatically the free groundwater surface at another location.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩支孔壓計讀值較大的那支，無論安裝高度如何都位於上游。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The higher pressure reading always identifies the upstream sensor regardless of installation elevation." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: An elevation-datum error systematically shifts inferred heads, while blockage or lost communication may mimic stability. A stage-only alarm without sediment observations can miss erosion developing even when measured pore-pressure changes remain modest.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.
